For my beans plot this season, I will save the fertilizer coupons for my maize garden if I get any — beans do not need much chemical fertilizer, and I recycle seed I kept from last harvest. I will put some manure from the goats on the plot before planting, which helps the soil. I cannot afford pesticides for beans, and we depend on the rains like everyone here in Dedza. I will work the plot mostly myself with help from my children, and maybe pay a neighbor for a few days of weeding if the rains come fast.
